scope: proved as stated; no universal source occupancy

claims.title: Exact affine E/M channel operator
claims.statement: A fixed original divisor is trace-admissible in both channels exactly when one trace gate holds and K divides p-1. On that locus c_E=c_M-(p-1)/K modulo D. The labelled count operator I+T is injective for odd D, has the displayed alternating inverse, and has orbit-parity cokernel (Z/2)^gcd(D,omega).

claims.title: Partial-chain quotient criterion
claims.statement: A strict radix chain ending at g reduces its complete-block paired count to B(Q_y+Q_{y-delta}). Uniform coverage is exactly the quotient support-cover condition; the sharp support threshold is (g+gcd(g,delta))/2, and residual steps in a proper subgroup cannot close the certificate.

claims.title: Mixed-order bounded section
claims.statement: Every coefficient is at least prod unused N times prod floor(N/m) under the displayed actual strict gcd chain. Exact inverse and carries.

claims.title: Finite certificate optimizer
claims.statement: Divisor DAG with at most n*tau(D) candidate edges gives the strongest lower bound in the specified chain class; no claim to decide all positivity.

claims.title: Original hard-prime realizations
claims.statement: Two reduced linear progressions realize uniform fine coefficients two while old unit width fails; second selected chain is entirely nonunit.

claims.title: Arithmetic last-capacity boundary
claims.statement: For arbitrary odd D and a strict chain, actual prime packets can have fine coefficient 1 outside H_m and 0 on H_m after one last digit is removed. The finite D=9 certificate records the exact stabilizer, exact-exponent progression, and a separate exterior witness for the same prime.

claims.title: Complete labelled plus-factor fibre
claims.statement: All cells and unit-ray E terminals with invariant 4a+s, their original inverses and canonical trace input fibres.

claims.title: Controlled upward prime family
claims.statement: p=67369+3775800k prime yields a proper M input and exact E target with a prime-support change and a increase exactly1.

claims.title: Fixed-fibre obstruction
claims.statement: At p97,a40,u2 the complete C83 fibre has three shells, all with both full gates empty.
